web.title: Digital coworkers: How AI agents are reshaping enterprise teams
web.description:
# Digital coworkers: How AI agents are reshaping enterprise teams
## Why enterprises are embracing AI employees
Forward-looking organizations are already redesigning workflows around this partnership. In [finance](https://www.datarobot.com/blog/cash-flow-forecasting/), agents handle “lights-out lending” processes around the clock while human analysts refine models and validate results. In operations, they monitor supply chains and surface insights before risks escalate.

The result: a more responsive, data-driven enterprise where people and AI each focus on what they do best.

## Preparing for the next phase of human + AI collaboration
AI agents are the digital employees that can learn your business context, [maintain governance](https://www.datarobot.com/blog/ai-governance-solutions/), streamline your processes, and develop institutional knowledge that stays in-house.

**Discover how** [**AI leaders**](https://www.datarobot.com/why-datarobot/leaders/) **are preparing their organizations for the agent workforce future.**

## **Frequently asked questions**
**What is a digital AI agent in enterprise teams?** A digital AI agent is an autonomous software system that acts as a coworker by monitoring conditions, making decisions, and coordinating tasks across departments without constant human supervision, unlike traditional chatbots or rule-based automation.

AI agents can reason through problems, evaluate alternatives, negotiate adjustments, and execute complex workflows 24/7 while maintaining governance and learning business context over time.

### What is a digital worker?
It is a type of [AI agent](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/).

### What is digital labor?
[Digital labor](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/digital-labor/) is the use of [agentic AI](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/what-is-agentic-ai/) technologies, such as [AI automation](https://www.salesforce.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-automation/) and AI agents, to execute operations that conventionally necessitate human judgment and cognitive capabilities.

web.title: Era of the AI Worker | What is is, Examples, Benefits & Use Cases
web.description:
# Era of the AI Worker
Where a chatbot replies and an AI agent handles one task, an AI worker reasons, remembers and connects to enterprise systems to complete real operational work, escalating to a person when a decision calls for it.

## What is the difference between AI workers and digital workers?
Essentially, AI workers are enterprise AI agents capable of adapting to new information, whereas digital workers focus on digital worker automation without learning or decision-making autonomy.

## How do AI workers fit into agentic AI?
AI workers are enterprise AI agents that execute AI workforce capabilities, make context-aware decisions and manage automation tools independently while interacting with human teams.
